entities.name: Construct
entities.description: A catch-all creature type for artificial life forms powered by mechanical means.

entities.name: Golems
entities.description: Artificial creatures created through magic, distinct from Constructs.

entities.name: Esperite artificers
entities.description: Alaran artificers who build specialized constructs out of etherium.

entities.name: Sundial

entities.name: Dawnchaser Pilgrims

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Reshaped Mirrodin, deliberately placing constructs there.
